model_scope: accepted axisymmetric maps to HEMP/CFT wall cusps, inter-cusp cells, wall-connected mirror paths, and orbit-gated uncertainty

relations.name: wall-cusp candidate
relations.equation: z_c is a quadratically interpolated local maximum of |B_r(r_wall,z)|; prominence=peak-max(left_support_min,right_support_min)
relations.validity: preregistered physical support half-width and cusp separation, independent of axial sample spacing

relations.name: converging wall bundle
relations.validity: endpoints arise from connected preregistered field-line traces, not hardware or finite-box roots

relations.name: HEMP cell
relations.validity: consecutive stable wall cusp planes; no O-point or closed-island requirement

relations.name: axial dominance
relations.validity: predeclared core radius and cell interior samples

relations.name: field-line trace
relations.validity: wall-event-aware adaptive RK stages never sample outside the physical wall and endpoint arclength error is bounded by wall tolerance

relations.name: same-line identity check
relations.validity: axisymmetric poloidal flux map and declared interpolation tolerance

relations.name: wall-connected extrema
relations.validity: one connected seed-to-channel-wall path with certified segment bounds

relations.name: mirror loss probability
relations.validity: 0<B_low<=B_high, isotropic pitch distribution, adiabatic and orbit gates passed

relations.name: field scale
relations.validity: certified positive field lower bound and finite gradient bound

relations.name: electron gyroradius ordering
relations.equation: rho_e=sqrt(2 m_e E sin^2(alpha))/(e B); rho_e/L_B<=epsilon_max
relations.validity: prescribed energy/pitch samples and nonrelativistic magnetized guiding-centre regime

relations.name: adiabatic invariant gate
relations.validity: converged claims match preregistered adapter/model/convergence IDs, versions, code hashes, and configuration hashes

relations.name: coverage-scaled uncertainty
relations.validity: finite positive coverage factor and overflow-safe bounds

relations.name: cross-map cusp assignment
relations.equation: sorted physical cusp i maps to i across primary/refined/enlarged maps and satisfies position/strength tolerances
relations.validity: same source, geometry, material, model, code, config, and backend identity

relations.name: cross-map path stability
relations.equation: same (cell_id,seed_id,direction) path mapping satisfies endpoint, cell-bound, and axial-metric tolerances
relations.validity: full preregistration evaluated atomically on all three accepted maps

relations.name: canonical record identity
relations.validity: all maps, identities, policies, registrations, outcomes, orbit claims, and coverage factor included

relations.name: held-out promotion
relations.equation: projectable = resolved AND accepted_projection_rebuilt(raw_map_artifacts,held_out_artifact,orbit_adapter,t_eval) AND manifest hashes recomputed AND development_case/family sets disjoint from held_out sets AND every held_out outcome passed AND evaluated (case,family,three-map hashes,three evidence fingerprints) is a manifest member
relations.validity: fresh adapter-verified maps and validation artifact/code/config under their preregistered maximum ages and future skews

relations.name: complete preregistration
relations.equation: H_pre=SHA256(criterion + development/held-out manifests + evaluated membership + three map hashes + three complete evidence fingerprints + geometry + ordered cells/seeds/directions/samples + all policies + orbit identity + required outcome count/case-family registrations + freshness policy)
relations.validity: frozen before held-out artifact evaluation; any orbit or validation implementation/configuration swap changes identity

relations.name: projection authority
relations.equation: rows(t_eval)=project(rebuild(private accepted raw map artifacts + private accepted held-out bytes + orbit adapter,t_eval))
relations.validity: explicit timezone-aware evaluation time; all map/held-out diagnostics, freshness, cusp/cell/path/orbit statuses, wall events, same-line extrema, probabilities, and coverage are rechecked atomically

relations.name: authoritative field artifact acceptance
relations.equation: E_map=reload_field_artifact_bytes(B_v1.2,allow_legacy_v1_1=false); B_v1.2=field_artifact_canonical_bytes(E_map); H_evidence binds payload hash + canonicalization + optional H(migration manifest,v1.1 source)
relations.validity: new held-out promotion requires canonical cft-axisymmetric-field-map/1.2.0 bytes with field-json-sorted-utf8-signed-zero-v2 semantics; v1.1 is historical unless a canonical migration manifest uniquely binds source and v1.2 target

source_basis.citation: Kornfeld et al., Physics and Evolution of HEMP-Thrusters, IEPC-2007-108
source_basis.supports: field mainly parallel to channel walls between cusps; radial wall crossing and mirror loss at cusp regions

source_basis.citation: Koch et al., The HEMPT Concept, IEPC-2011-236
source_basis.supports: linear magnetic multi-cusp structure alternating predominant axial and radial field

source_basis.citation: Dannenmayer et al., Simplified Optimization of the Magnetic Configuration of HEMP-Thrusters, Applied Sciences 13 (2023) 3491
source_basis.supports: field-line start-to-wall endpoint mirror ratio and cusp-localized plasma-wall interaction

source_basis.citation: Cary and Brizard, Hamiltonian theory of guiding-center motion, Rev. Mod. Phys. 81 (2009) 693
source_basis.supports: guiding-centre ordering and magnetic-moment adiabatic invariant

criterion_status.validation: requires a new preregistered held-out geometry family before search-v3 projection

prohibited_shortcuts: requiring an X-point, O-point, null, or closed island to define a wall cusp
defining a HEMP cell from a closed constant-psi contour
using hardware, axial endpoint, or computational-box roots as cusp evidence
comparing magnetic fields from different connected field lines
treating a computational boundary as the dielectric channel wall
publishing a mirror probability after null, rho/L_B, orbit, invariant, uncertainty, or map-stability failure
accepting only a successful subset of preregistered seeds, directions, energies, or pitch samples
using the assessed 56-case characterization as validation evidence
trusting caller-declared disjoint or all-passed booleans instead of recomputing manifest membership and outcomes
sampling an RK stage outside the dielectric channel wall before resolving the wall event
treating a caller-rehashed summary record or copyable canonical seal as projection authority
binding held-out membership only to field-value hashes while ignoring schema/model/code/config/backend/provenance/diagnostic identity
promoting direct v1.1 field bytes or a v1.2 rewrite without a uniquely bound canonical migration manifest
projecting deprecated v2 screening proxies or v3 closed-contour records as v4 CFT cells
using fixed axial windows instead of consecutive stable wall-cusp planes
